complexity_review: KMP prefix transitions plus lower/upper tight digit DP. O(26*n*m) time and O(26*m) auxiliary space, m=len(evil). Each modular addition stays below 2*modulus and is exact in JS.
evidence_scope: prospective finite public-domain output/type/local-effects qualification, not universal proof
objective: Count length-n lowercase strings in the inclusive lexical interval that do not contain evil; return modulo 1000000007.
official_domain: 1<=n<=500; len(s1)=len(s2)=n; s1<=s2; 1<=len(evil)<=50; all strings lowercase ASCII.
provenance: Owner-provided existing implementations, independently reviewed against official public statement; original files unchanged.
